## 

## Website Design

This website was created using RStudio and Quarto and is published through GitHub Pages. I used the Cosmo theme because it provides a clean and professional appearance that is appropriate for an academic website.

The navigation bar is organized so that visitors can easily access the main sections of the website. The Home page provides a brief introduction and summarizes my research interests. The Research page presents my current research and working papers, while the Teaching page summarizes my teaching experience. The CV page provides access to my current curriculum vitae, and the Assignments menu contains course-related materials.

I chose a simple layout with minimal visual elements so that the focus remains on the content. I also considered readability and ease of navigation when designing the website. The colors, fonts, and overall structure are kept simple and consistent across the pages. Because the primary purpose of the website is to present my academic work, I wanted visitors to be able to quickly find information about my research, teaching, and CV without unnecessary visual elements.

The website also includes direct links to my GitHub profile and email address so that visitors can easily find additional information or contact me. The same navigation structure is used across the website to provide a consistent user experience.

The website was built as a Quarto project in RStudio. The rendered HTML files are stored in the `docs` folder and published through GitHub Pages. This structure allows me to update the website by editing the Quarto files, rendering the site again, and pushing the updated files to GitHub.
